text: Tulsi Gabbard Has Said Iran’s Government Remains Intact Despite Ongoing Us And Israeli Strikes |N18GUS Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard has said Iran’s government remains intact despite ongoing US and Israeli strikes, though its military strength has been significantly weakened. Testifying before a Senate hearing, Gabbard stated that Iran’s leadership structure is still functioning, but its conventional military capabilities and power projection have been largely degraded, leaving Tehran with limited strategic options. #tulsigabbard #iran #usisrael #middleeastwar #iranconflict #warupdate #hezbollah #globaltensions #waralert #uspolitics #israeliran News18 Mobile App - https://onelink.to/desc-youtube
